title: Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.14542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. translated_title: 多模态基准真的有用吗？基于结构-响应协同校准的条目级多模态基准诊断
translated_abstract: 多模态基准是评估模型能否对来自多种模态的信息进行推理的核心工具。然而，现有研究已经揭示，一些基准可能包含“捷径条目”，这些条目仅凭单一模态或答案选项的规律即可作答，因而无法反映模型真正的跨模态推理能力。现有的基准评估方法通常要么依赖条目的内在结构，要么依赖模型的外在响应行为，二者均不足以实现全面的诊断。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SRCoD，一个结构-响应协同校准的诊断框架，用于对多模态基准中的模态依赖性进行条目级诊断。SRCoD从基准内容和目标答案中估计样本级的多模态信息结构，并将该信号作为模态条件条目响应建模的软结构锚点。学习到的模型产生校准后的条目级诊断信号……
tldr: 提出了SRCoD框架，通过结构-响应协同校准对多模态基准进行条目级诊断，识别仅凭单一模态或选项规律即可作答的捷径条目，从而更全面地衡量基准能否真正反映模型的跨模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level identification of modality dependence and shortcut items in multimodal benchmarks, enabling more comprehensive assessment of whether benchmarks truly measure cross-modal reasoning ability.
